avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4/2C19 induction reduces vortioxetine levels; increased risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue St. John's Wort before starting vortioxetine or avoid concurrent use

avoid_supplements.name: Serotonergic herbs (SAMe, L-tryptophan, 5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity)

avoid_supplements.name: Linezolid
avoid_supplements.mechanism: MAOI-like activity combined with serotonin reuptake inhibition increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution and close monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive antiplatelet effects; vortioxetine may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising or bleeding; consider alternative supplement

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high doses)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects may add to increased bleeding risk with vortioxetine
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bleeding signs; keep doses moderate (≤2-3 g/day combined EPA+DHA)

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (if used with other serotonergic agents)
avoid_foods.mechanism: While vortioxetine is not an MAOI, combined use with other agents may increase hypertensive risk
avoid_foods.action: Minimal restriction with vortioxetine alone; counsel if combined with other serotonergic drugs

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depression and impair judgment/coordination
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit or avoid alcohol; assess impact on individual basis

caution_foods.name: Caffeine (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase anxiety, insomnia, or agitation in some patients; mild CYP1A2 interaction
caution_foods.action: Advise moderation; monitor for increased side effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome, especially if combined with other serotonergic agents. Assess CYP2D6 metabolism and adjust dose if coadministered with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors. Counsel on alcohol limitation and watch for emerging or worsening suicidal ideation.
